scripts.build: npm run build -w @nexplay/shared && npm run build -w @nexplay/api && npm run build -w @nexplay/web && npm run build -w @nexplay/desktop && npm run build -w @sausixudos/music-bot
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @nexplay/shared && npm run typecheck -w @nexplay/api && npm run typecheck -w @nexplay/web && npm run typecheck -w @nexplay/desktop && npm run typecheck -w @sausixudos/music-bot
scripts.test: npm run build -w @nexplay/shared && npm run test -w @nexplay/api && npm run test -w @nexplay/web && npm run test -w @sausixudos/music-bot
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @nexplay/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @nexplay/api" "npm run dev -w @nexplay/web"
scripts.desktop:dev: docker compose up -d livekit pot-provider && npm run build -w @nexplay/shared && concurrently -k -s first -n api,web,music,desktop -c blue,magenta,yellow,green "cross-env NODE_ENV=development WEB_ORIGIN=http://localhost:5173 COOKIE_SECURE=false LIVEKIT_PUBLIC_URL=ws://localhost:5173/livekit LIVEKIT_INTERNAL_URL=http://localhost:7880 MUSIC_BOT_INTERNAL_URL=http://localhost:4100 npm run dev -w @nexplay/api" "npm run dev -w @nexplay/web" "cross-env LIVEKIT_INTERNAL_URL=http://localhost:7880 npm run dev -w @sausixudos/music-bot" "npm run dev -w @nexplay/desktop"
